subject: Best Strategy to Save Streaming Data

messages.author: c6ca7877bef91eef
messages.subject: Best Strategy to Save Streaming Data
parts:
I created a Shiny App to display near real-time insight into availability of bikes in NYC

http://glimmer.rstudio.com/ramnathv/NYCBikeShare/

I realized that since I am collecting the data every 10 minutes, I might as well save it, so that one can analyze deeper patterns into usage.

I was wondering, what is the best way to do this since it is going to be a lot of data. 

Any advice would be much appreciated.

Best,
Ramnath

messages.author: 55771919c42cb6a1
messages.subject: Re: Best Strategy to Save Streaming Data
parts:
Have you looked at RSQLite? It's a wrapper around SQLite, which is a standalone binary (no separate database server process), and should be able to handle (at least) several gigabytes just fine. SQLite also has a solid reputation - it's embedded into many software products that you probably use:
http://www.sqlite.org/famous.html

-Winston
